rationale: Despite gapping down and selling off early on massive relative volume (7.27x), JD has established a bottom and reclaimed both the 5m 9-EMA ($25.72) and session VWAP ($25.76). The last five 1-minute candles show tight consolidation just above VWAP followed by an uptick in price and volume on the most recent bar, signaling buyer absorption and potential for an afternoon mean-reversion move toward the open. Invalidation is placed just below the 9-EMA and VWAP support zone.
